milestones.title: v0.2.0 – Multilingual UI
milestones.description: 11 languages with English as default, automated releases.

issues.title: Multilingual UI: i18n framework, language picker, English default
issues.body: Move every UI and user-facing backend text into translation catalogs. Setting `general.language` (default `en`, `auto` = system language). Live switching, Intl formatting for dates/numbers, plural rules. Data (genres, folders, tags) stays language-independent.

issues.title: Translations: de, zh-CN, hi, es, fr, bn, pt-BR, ru, id, nl
issues.body: Complete catalogs for the ten languages next to English, with key/placeholder parity tests. See docs/TRANSLATING.md for how to help.

issues.title: Fonts for CJK, Devanagari, Bengali and long-label checks
issues.body: `dir=rtl` layout with logical CSS properties, font fallbacks for non-Latin scripts, screenshots per language for visual review.

issues.title: Automated GitHub releases
issues.body: Pushing a new version to `main` creates the tag, the release (notes from CHANGELOG) and attaches installer, portable ZIP, source ZIP and SHA256SUMS.

milestones.title: v0.3.0 – Festivals & series
milestones.description: Recognise festival/series, year, stage and set type; browse the library by festival.

issues.title: Festival & series data model and offline detection
issues.body: Series (festival, radio show, podcast) with aliases, editions (series + year), stage and set type per mix. Detection only from metadata already stored – no extra requests. Editable list of known festivals, manual correction by clicking the badge. See docs/concepts/festivals.md.

issues.title: Library: group by festival / series / artist / year
issues.body: Festival tiles with counts, years as a timeline, sets grouped by stage, filter chips.

issues.title: Festival tags and path placeholders
issues.body: ID3 `FESTIVAL`, `EVENT_YEAR`, `STAGE`, `SET_TYPE`; album tag = edition (switchable) for Plex/Jellyfin; placeholders `{festival}`, `{event_year}`, `{stage}` – default path template unchanged.

milestones.title: v0.4.0 – Read everything (once)
milestones.description: Fetch the complete back catalogue of a watchlist source.

issues.title: Watchlist: read the whole back catalogue of a source once
issues.body: Paged, throttled and resumable (after backoff, restart or cancel), adjustable cap (~2000), results always go to the inbox, progress shown at the source, confirmation with the estimated number of requests.

milestones.title: v0.5.0 – Festival collector
milestones.description: Collect all sets of a festival edition with a checklist.

issues.title: Festival collector: checklist per edition
issues.body: Expected sets (DJ, stage, day/time, set type) with status and checkboxes; only ticked and confirmed sets are queued. Missing sets are searched one by one within the throttle limits, resumable.

issues.title: Timetable sources: organiser playlists, pasted timetable, shared timetable files
issues.body: Organiser playlist as cheapest source, a parser for pasted timetables (text/CSV), community-curated `timetables/<series>/<year>.json`. No scraping of festival websites.

milestones.title: v0.6.0 – Tracklist search
milestones.description: Find out which sets play a given track.

issues.title: Extract tracklists from chapters and descriptions
issues.body: Parse artist – title lines and timestamps from chapters, descriptions and CUE data already stored.

issues.title: Search: which sets play track X?
issues.body: Search across all tracklists in the library and jump straight to the position in the player.

milestones.title: v0.7.0 – Loudness & player
milestones.description: Even volume and a better player for long sets.

issues.title: Loudness normalisation (ReplayGain / EBU R128 tags)
issues.body: Analyse offline with ffmpeg and write gain tags so all sets play at the same volume; no re-encoding.

issues.title: Player: remember position, waveform with chapter marks, sleep timer
issues.body: Resume long sets where you left off, show a waveform with chapter marks, optional sleep timer.

milestones.title: v0.8.0 – Playlists & DJ pages
milestones.description: Export playlists and browse by DJ.

issues.title: Playlist export (M3U per festival, genre or DJ)
issues.body: Export playlists with relative paths for phones, USB sticks and car radios.

issues.title: DJ pages with aliases
issues.body: All sets of an artist in one place, alias handling, add to watchlist in one click.

milestones.title: v0.9.0 – Statistics & integrations
milestones.description: Statistics, notifications and media server integration.

issues.title: Statistics view
issues.body: Hours of music, top DJs, sets per year/festival/genre.

issues.title: Windows notifications for new watchlist sets
issues.body: Toast when the watchlist finds new sets, optionally with a «Download now» action.

issues.title: Plex / Jellyfin library scan after downloads
issues.body: Optionally trigger a library scan on the media server once downloads finish.

issues.title: Detect re-uploads via audio fingerprint
issues.body: Recognise the same set uploaded under a different title before downloading it twice.

issues.title: New sources: Mixcloud and hearthis.at
issues.body: Search and watchlist support with their own throttle settings.

issues.title: New source: archive.org (optional)
issues.body: Hardcore/gabber archive collections from the Internet Archive.

milestones.title: Signed installer
milestones.description: Code-signed installer and app so Windows SmartScreen no longer warns. Not tied to a feature release.

issues.title: Code signing certificate for open source
issues.body: Evaluate and apply: SignPath Foundation (free for OSS, GitHub Actions integration), Certum Open Source Code Signing, Azure Trusted Signing (availability for individuals in Switzerland to be checked). Choose one and set up the certificate/identity.

issues.title: Sign installer and binaries in the release workflow
issues.body: Sign `HCLoader-Setup-<version>.exe` (and the uninstaller via Inno Setup SignTool) in `portable.yml`, timestamped; verify the signature in CI; secrets only in GitHub environment secrets. Update docs (remove SmartScreen hint).
